stage0065_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$宗介$$
「You wanted to talk to me about
　something, Captain $$スメラギ$$?」

stage0065_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「You must have some idea, don't you?」

stage0065_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$宗介$$
「...Is this about how inadequate I was
　in our last operation?」

stage0065_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「Good, at least you're aware of it.
　I'm not your commanding officer, anyway.」

stage0065_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「This... could this help with your slump?」

stage0065_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$宗介$$
「This memo... is it someone's phone number?」

stage0065_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「It's the cell number for someone named $$レイス$$.」

stage0065_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「You should thank her.
　Getting someone's direct line outside her
　jurisdiction... $$テッサ$$ really pushed for it.」

stage0065_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「This is as far as she and I can help.
　Whether you use that number is up to you.」

stage0065_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「That gratitude...
　say it to $$テッサ$$, when you get the chance.」

stage0065_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$かなめ$$
（$$宗介$$'s safe house...
　it's been completely cleared out...）

stage0065_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$かなめ$$
（What does this mean...?
　Is Sousuke never coming back to Jindai High...?）

stage0065_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$かなめ$$
（From the way they're acting,
　even $$甲児$$ and the others don't seem to know
　what happened to $$宗介$$...）

stage0065_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$かなめ$$
（Just what is going on,
　somewhere I don't even know about...?）

stage0065_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
???
（So he's learned $$相良宗介$$ was relieved.
　If that settles him down some, guarding him
　gets easier for me too...）

stage0065_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$宗介$$
「So you know my voice...
　So it's true you were secretly
　guarding Chidori.」

stage0065_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$レイス$$
「How did you get this number?」

stage0065_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$レイス$$
「I don't have time for this.
　$$千鳥かなめ$$ is getting away.」

stage0065_03:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$宗介$$
「Is your mission guarding $$千鳥かなめ$$?
　Or is it surveillance?」

stage0065_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$レイス$$
「I have no obligation to answer.」

stage0065_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$レイス$$
「...Fine.
　For the sake of whoever gave you this number,
　I'll humor you a little.」

stage0065_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$レイス$$
「Of course the answer is guarding her.」

stage0065_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$レイス$$
「Think what you like.
　But my mission is to prevent
　$$千鳥かなめ$$ from falling into other hands.」

stage0065_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$宗介$$
「Then why not help her?
　There have been dangerous moments before.」

stage0065_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$レイス$$
「You mean the incident with A21...
　That was caused by an unexpected
　factor, Captain Testarossa.」

stage0065_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$レイス$$
「Say what you like.
　Either way, her $$ウィスパード$$ knowledge
　was never drawn out of her.」

stage0065_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$レイス$$
「That is the one thing I must protect.
　Unless someone approaches her aiming for it,
　there's no need for me to step in.」

stage0065_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$宗介$$
「There's your true feelings.
　So her life itself doesn't interest you?」

stage0065_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$レイス$$
「At minimum, I protect her life,
　so it doesn't come to the worst.」

stage0065_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$レイス$$
「I don't need you to believe me.
　Go ahead and fret all you like.」

stage0065_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$レイス$$
「As for me, without that pastime,
　my days will get a bit dull.」

stage0065_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$レイス$$
「While watching $$千鳥かなめ$$,
　I aimed a rifle at you more than once.」

stage0065_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$レイス$$
「Your fine warrior's instincts pick up
　killing intent so well.
　Your overreaction was quite a show.」

stage0065_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$宗介$$
「The killing intent I felt in $$第２新東京市$$...
　That was you?!」

stage0065_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$レイス$$
「Don't be so angry.
　We're both professionals.
　Let's skip the pointless squabbling.」

stage0065_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$宗介$$
「That won't do.
　What about Chidori's safety?」

stage0065_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$レイス$$
「That's no longer your concern.
　Or will you defy orders and return to Japan?」

stage0065_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$レイス$$
「Don't forget your life in $$第２新東京市$$
　was provided by $$ミスリル$$.」

stage0065_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$レイス$$
「You were never truly a student.
　Just a mercenary.
　Your whole identity is a forgery.」

stage0065_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$レイス$$
「Seems you finally understand your position.」

stage0065_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$レイス$$
「You criticize me, but do you honestly
　believe someone like you
　can keep protecting her?」

stage0065_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$レイス$$
「These past months, you never adapted
　to Japanese society at all.
　You only expose her to needless danger.」

stage0065_03:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$レイス$$
「Unfortunately, you're a third-rate
　bodyguard at best. You're nothing but
　harm to her, and might drag others in too.」

stage0065_03:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$宗介$$
「I have no reason to hear that from you!」

stage0065_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$レイス$$
「This conversation is over.
　Go do your own duty.」

stage0065_03:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$レイス$$
「$$相良宗介$$, is it...
　What a strange one...」

stage0065_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$デュオ$$
「So you and $$マリー$$ were traveling
　around the world together, huh.」

stage0065_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$アレルヤ$$
「To be precise, $$ハレルヤ$$ and
　$$ソーマ・ピーリス$$ were along too.」

stage0065_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$カトル$$
「And did you find your answer?」

stage0065_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$マリー$$
「I don't know...
　But that journey was precious time for us.」

stage0065_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$アレルヤ$$
「We still don't know where
　our place is in this world.」

stage0065_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$アレルヤ$$
「But the world needs power like ours...
　I've come to understand that, bit by bit.」

stage0065_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$マリー$$
「From letters from everyone at
　$$２１世紀警備保障$$, I learned about $c too.」

stage0065_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$マリー$$
「And just as we planned to join you all,
　we ended up meeting like this.」

stage0065_03:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$刹那$$
「It may be against my wishes, but
　welcome, $$アレルヤ$$, $$マリー$$.」

stage0065_03:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$ロックオン$$
「So basically, your place was here all along.」

stage0065_03:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「I thought the same, when I joined too.」

stage0065_03:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Man, I'm jealous though.
　A round-the-world hike with the girl
　you're sweet on. Right, $$宗介$$?」

stage0065_03:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$スズネ$$
（Completely lost in thought, isn't he.）

stage0065_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$n
（Things have gotten worse than yesterday.
　What on earth happened to $$宗介$$...）

stage0065_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Sorry to drag you out at a bad time.
　Tonight's a small welcome party for you all.」

stage0065_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$ヒルデ$$
「This camp under the night sky, you mean?」

stage0065_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Pretty nice, isn't it, $$ヒルデ$$?」

stage0065_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$ヒルデ$$
「...I can't really get into that mood.」

stage0065_03:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$マオ$$
「That's a normal reaction.
　After all, we're smack in the middle
　of Amalgam's encirclement.」

stage0065_03:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Flip it around, and it means we don't
　need to run or hide. Just stand tall.」

stage0065_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$アレルヤ$$
「But it's reassuring,
　especially in a situation like this.」

stage0065_03:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$クルツ$$
「$n!
　Is the food ready yet!」

stage0065_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$n
「Leave cooking in a place like this to me.」

stage0065_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$刹那$$
「...This reminds me of the $$破界事変$$.」

stage0065_03:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「True. Back then, depending on
　the mission, we sometimes had no choice
　but to camp out like this.」

stage0065_03:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$アレルヤ$$
「With $$ロックオン$$ along, the food
　was always great.」

stage0065_03:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$ロックオン$$
「Huh... my brother was good at cooking?」

stage0065_03:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Here, $$刹那$$... I cut the apple
　into little rabbits.」

stage0065_03:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$スズネ$$
「I heard from $$郁絵$$ at Takeo General Company.
　That you like your apples cut like this.」

stage0065_03:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$カレン$$
（Hey, hey... don't you think the way
　$$フェルト$$ looks at $$刹那$$ has changed?）

stage0065_03:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
（More importantly, isn't the pizza done yet?）

stage0065_03:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$カレン$$
（I was a fool for bringing that up with you...）

stage0065_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Won't you take off the mask, $$ゼロ$$?」

stage0065_03:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「This is a matter of principle.
　I am $$ゼロ$$, and nothing else.」

stage0065_03:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Then get away from the campfire.
　Sweat's dripping down your mask.」

stage0065_03:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$スザク$$
「I bet he's drenched in sweat under there」

stage0065_03:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Well then!
　Let's raise a toast and blow this crisis away!」

stage0065_03:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$カトル$$
「That uniform...
　Could you be a liaison from $$ミスリル$$?」

stage0065_03:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Oh...!
　Judging by that insignia, you're a lieutenant!」

stage0065_03:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Sorry about that.
　Coming all the way out to a hassle like this」

stage0065_03:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Well, call it fate, huh?
　Let's get three drinks in you to welcome you!
　Oh, and I want to see your good side, Lieutenant!」

stage0065_03:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Figures, from a coward's subordinate.
　You don't understand the situation at all」

stage0065_03:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「I said your superior officer,
　$$ウルズ$$ 1's $$ゲイル・マッカラン$$, is a coward」

stage0065_03:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Or call him incompetent.
　Shot by a traitor and badly hurt, how fitting for him」

stage0065_03:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Speak up if you object.
　Though I doubt anyone with that kind
　of backbone is at this carefree campfire」

stage0065_03:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Ha ha... quite the entrance, Lieutenant.
　What a surprise guest...」

stage0065_03:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「What's wrong, Sergeant?
　Missing a sneak attack? Some sniper you are」

stage0065_03:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$クルツ$$
「You bastard!
　Insulting old man $$マッカラン$$ like that,
　don't think you'll get off easy!」

stage0065_03:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「This is how you attack」

stage0065_03:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Heh... you son of a bitch...!
　Took a hit, and now I'm all fired up...」

stage0065_03:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「He's just unconscious.
　Throw some water on him, he'll wake up」

stage0065_03:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「I'm surprised he didn't drop from that hit,
　but between him, and that captain in rehab,
　this $$ＳＲＴ$$ is nothing but fools」

stage0065_03:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「You look like you want to say something」

stage0065_03:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$宗介$$
「Lieutenant... I apologize for my comrade's rudeness.
　But please retract your insult toward Captain $$マッカラン$$」

stage0065_03:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「What's wrong? Won't you take a swing
　at your superior like this fool did? ...Thought not」

stage0065_03:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「From what I see, you're a serious man.
　But you can't do anything without orders」

stage0065_03:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「In other words, you're a coward.
　You need an excuse to hide behind」

stage0065_03:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$n
「Don't stop me...!
　I can't stay quiet after he insulted my comrade like that!」

stage0065_03:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「This is a $$ミスリル$$ matter.
　Leave it to $$宗介$$ first」

stage0065_03:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Then how about this, Sergeant...
　how about a little game,
　as entertainment for the campfire?」

stage0065_03:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「You want to defend $$マッカラン$$'s honor, right?
　Perfect timing...
　Let everyone here serve as judges」

stage0065_03:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Can't decide, hm?
　Then I'll use the magic word」

stage0065_03:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「How rare.
　For you to care about someone like that」

stage0065_03:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Whaaat!?
　The kitten sisters $$玉芳$$ and $$玉蘭$$
　skipped town overnight!?」

stage0065_03:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
Amalgam
「It seems they never rejoined after the retreat, and just left」

stage0065_03:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Oh!
　Since two of them ran,
　I guess I need to kill one more to even the score!」

stage0065_03:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「It's a joke, a joke!
　You just don't get sarcasm!」

stage0065_03:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「So, where'd the lolita girls go?」

stage0065_03:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Fine, got it!
　I'll give you three seconds!」

stage0065_03:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「...Too bad.
　If you'd grown out your sideburns, you wouldn't have died」

stage0065_03:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
???
「Taking a subordinate's life so carelessly is hardly admirable」

stage0065_03:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Shut uuup!
　Don't you dare talk back to me!」

stage0065_03:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「Quite the quick draw, but it won't work on me」

stage0065_03:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Who the hell are you, huh?」

stage0065_03:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「We were dispatched from $$マーティアル$$ Order HQ.
　I believe you've already been informed」

stage0065_03:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Now that you mention it, someone did...
　Hey, Subordinate A! You listening?」

stage0065_03:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Oh yeah... then what about Subordinate B?」

stage0065_03:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Ugh, come on!
　None of you are any good!」

stage0065_03:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「That's enough.
　A meaningless execution like this
　isn't the kind of battle $$マーティアル$$'s god ordains」

stage0065_03:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「You think you can talk back to me, huh?」

stage0065_03:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「Draw your gun again.
　If you want, I'll be your opponent」

stage0065_03:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「$$テイタニア・ダ・モンテ＝ウェルズ$$.」

stage0065_03:r_3ad10e705167a3fa.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「I'll be with your unit for a while.
　If you have complaints, come at me anytime」

stage0065_03:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「$$テイタニア・ダ・モンテ＝ウェルズ$$...」

stage0065_03:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$カレン$$
「$$宗介$$...
　You need to quit it already」

stage0065_03:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$カレン$$
「It's not that I don't get how you feel,
　but you're going to die if you keep this up」

stage0065_03:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$デュオ$$
「$$カレン$$'s got every right to be mad.
　Didn't think you were this sensitive」

stage0065_03:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Alright alright, break it up!
　If we all pile on, this guy's brooding
　is just gonna get worse」

stage0065_03:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Let's rest for now.
　We're still surrounded by the enemy」

stage0065_03:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$$カトル$$
「You're right.
　We should rest while we can」

stage0065_03:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$n
「See you, $$宗介$$.
　Get some sleep and clear your head too」

stage0065_03:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Don't sweat it.
　More importantly, let's think of a way
　to deal with that lieutenant」

stage0065_03:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$クルツ$$
「As far as I'm concerned, he's more
　of a threat than Amalgam or $$マーティアル$$」

stage0065_03:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Seems like we fell hook, line, and sinker
　for that farce you set up」

stage0065_03:r_304e98dac43c9333.text:
$$クルツ$$
「But that doesn't mean
　I'm gonna go and respect you」

stage0065_03:r_c33abf00683a32bc.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Sergeant Sagara... do you know why you lost to me?」

stage0065_03:r_019293cb83599509.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Wrong.
　The reason runs deeper than that.
　One no skill can ever make up for.」

stage0065_03:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$宗介$$
「I don't understand what you mean...」

stage0065_03:r_b39a1dd705fe6cbf.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「You loathe that Arbalest of yours.」

stage0065_03:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Fighting you, I understood it well.
　Your footwork, your strikes, every blow you threw...
　All of it carried hesitation, carried haste.」

stage0065_03:r_cf907a4d5de8b5c9.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Your mind wasn't in it.
　The Lambda Driver doesn't matter.
　The problem lies before that.」

stage0065_03:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「To defeat you and your Arbalest
　needed no Lambda Driver at all.
　I proved that myself, just now.」

stage0065_03:r_4ae9c4bd77494c4a.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Listen well, Sergeant.
　The weapon we call an AS is no mere machine.
　It is an extension of a trained warrior's body.」

stage0065_03:r_7313331f4077d255.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「A pilot's heart shows through in the machine.
　At a high enough level of combat,
　that slight difference decides victory.」

stage0065_03:r_414e6e90094d1413.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Know this: a man who doesn't trust
　his own body will never beat what's to come.
　That's all.」

stage0065_03:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Given this, I'll retrain you hard, starting tomorrow.
　Weber... and you too, eavesdropping over there.」

stage0065_03:r_7b3a37f5039eb1f6.text:
$$クルツ$$
「No way...
　Sensing $n from that distance...」

stage0065_03:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Train hard enough, and you'll manage
　that much too. Brace yourself.」

stage0065_03:r_ddd97a6ef823929a.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Tch... what an insufferable guy just showed up.」

stage0065_03:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$n
「Still, I have to admit his skill.」

stage0065_03:r_de3cc1f733dcb073.text:
$n
「Let's do this, $$宗介$$.
　Neither of us can end here, not like this.」

stage0065_03:r_b01db8213417811e.text:
$$宗介$$
「$$スザク$$...
　why do you concern yourself with me?」

stage0065_03:r_660c72e627d873c7.text:
$$スザク$$
「$$カレン$$ told me the story.
　That you were a mercenary, but going to school
　slowly brought your humanity back...」

stage0065_03:r_6ccd85652ef4ccf1.text:
$$宗介$$
「You, who were a Knight of the Round...」

stage0065_03:r_fbe7bf7d854012a7.text:
$$スザク$$
「The days I spent at $$アッシュフォード学園$$
　I'll never forget them...」

stage0065_03:r_1f438885dbc1359e.text:
$$スザク$$
「So, $$宗介$$...
　I want you to keep going.」

stage0065_03:r_df899b8031b4ca06.text:
$$恵理$$
「This... came in the mail to the office just now...」

stage0065_03:r_c5d048c7db7cac75.text:
$$かなめ$$
「A withdrawal notice...!?
　Don't tell me this is...」

stage0065_03:r_308e8ac66b1141ef.text:
$$恵理$$
「From your face, you didn't know either.
　...It's Sagara's.」

stage0065_03:r_b6ca80db4741a62c.text:
$$恵理$$
「He was always so devoted to the Volunteer Club...
　Chidori, does anything come to mind?」

stage0065_03:r_9f7c18d1ea1b55c9.text:
$$恵理$$
「I'll hold onto this for the time being,
　but even that's only good for a month...」

stage0065_03:r_9547b3241808695f.text:
$$かなめ$$
（Calm down, he's not here anymore...
　I don't know what happened, but
　even if someone comes after you, he won't save you...）

stage0065_03:r_32b2a8ce24deeb9f.text:
$$かなめ$$
（Whoever's after me
　is definitely watching me from somewhere.）

stage0065_03:r_c7ef92060bb8199d.text:
$$かなめ$$
（With $n and $$甲児$$ and the others gone,
　I need to figure out a plan...
　I can't drag the teachers or Kyoko into this...!）

stage0065_03:r_80f948aeaed93de8.text:
$$かなめ$$
（Get a grip, $$千鳥かなめ$$!
　You're not some princess who does nothing
　but sigh at the top of a tower...!）

stage0065_03:r_0d24e9726dcc79f9.text:
$$かなめ$$
（First, information...
　I need to grasp what's happening
　around me...!）

stage0065_03:r_ef339c6f71e7560f.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Too bad, Master $$クルツ$$.
　You did beat that $$クルーゾー$$ jerk once.」

stage0065_03:r_ce68dd10a19e01ea.text:
$$クルツ$$
「What's that, $$ＡＧ$$?
　Calling the Lieutenant a jerk?」

stage0065_03:r_075101b23517fbaa.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Is that so?
　Don't you call me 'that $$クルツ$$ jerk'
　when you're in front of him?」

stage0065_03:r_6f4f8dd80820f5e7.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Anyway, you cozying up to me like this
　means you made Z-Chips off that game.
　So, how much did you get?」

stage0065_03:r_6cf1e5ed68d98bd4.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Add that to the squad's stock.
　I've got something else for you to do instead.」

stage0065_03:r_d72cc2c0739c9088.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Dig up dirt on that jerk.」

stage0065_03:r_e5a692ea5ce09cac.text:
$$クルツ$$
「He's only human.
　Go through his stuff, his letters,
　something's bound to turn up.」

stage0065_03:r_e793fc3ce3a0c28d.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Count on you, $$ＡＧ$$.
　Our crack agent robot.」

stage0065_03:r_2be6c657d0e12c4b.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Can't be helped, I suppose.
　Since it's Master $$クルツ$$ asking, I'll do my best.」

stage0065_03:r_f89f6c6c4b076e16.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now then, please look forward to it.」

stage0065_03:r_b43bdba9393d4d68.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes! Absolutely!
　I love missions like this!」

stage0065_03:r_b26be73e3c0c8bed.text:
$$スズネ$$
「$$マオ$$... you and that $$クルーゾー$$
　have known each other for a while, haven't you?」

stage0065_03:r_b8902c992035da79.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Even if he's your superior officer,
　you were acting oddly distant for you,
　$$マオ$$.」

stage0065_03:r_df10ad0a71c307da.text:
$$マオ$$
「I lost.
　Guess that's what it takes to run
　that Volunteer Club bunch of dunces.」

stage0065_03:r_9293c52555ba1457.text:
$$スズネ$$
「By the way, $$クルーゾー$$
　doesn't seem like such a bad person either.」

stage0065_03:r_ca702b5726ebd4da.text:
$$スズネ$$
「He seemed to know a lot about
　$$マッカラン$$'s rehab progress too.」

stage0065_03:r_51ce1d8caa34c103.text:
$$マオ$$
「Ben, I mean, Lieutenant $$クルーゾー$$,
　was a comrade of Captain $$マッカラン$$'s.
　That's probably why he took over $$ウルズ$$ 1.」

stage0065_03:r_d00313056b19262c.text:
$$マオ$$
「He went out of his way to play the villain.
　Keep this a secret from $$宗介$$ and the others.」

stage0065_03:r_2c37dd5b8f919a88.text:
$$マオ$$
「That's how it is, $$ＡＧ$$.
　You keep the secret too.」

stage0065_03:r_53f5199f05a9aad8.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh no... you noticed after all.
　And I thought I'd found Master $$クルーゾー$$'s weakness...」

stage0065_03:r_c6937f14a8985c35.text:
$$マオ$$
「I'll make it up to you instead.
　With Miss $$スズネ$$.」

stage0065_03:r_d90c4affdd742a0e.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「In that case, gladly!
　Now then, shall we get started!」
